C0034.title: Scalper Buys Personal Information and Uses AI Face Swapping to Buy Moutai
C0034.summary: In December 2025, media reported a Moutai scalping case in which suspects bought more than 3,400 pieces of citizens' personal information and used AI face-swapping techniques to bypass real-name reservation and facial-recognition checks. They purchased more than 60 bottles of Moutai for resale profit. The case shows how scalpers can combine black-market personal information with AI face-swapping services to expand malicious purchasing capability.

references.title: Selling Citizens' Personal Information and Illegally Bypassing Facial Recognition Systems
Scalper buys over 3,400 pieces of personal data, uses AI face-swapping to snatch 60+ bottles of Moutai—is this illegal?
